group.label: Connection
group.comment: Create the keys in your AskMerra dashboard, under API keys. One AskMerra shop has one currency: a store view in another currency (or another brand) connects to its own AskMerra shop - switch the scope to that store view and enter its keys there.

field.label: Secret key
field.comment: Starts with sk_live_. Used only by the server to send your catalog; it is stored encrypted and never reaches the storefront.

field.label: Site key
field.comment: Starts with pk_live_. The public key of the chat widget. Add this store's domain to the allowed domains of your AskMerra shop.

field.label: Language
field.comment: The language this store view's products are sent in and the assistant answers in. Automatic uses the store view's locale (Stores > Configuration > General > Locale Options) when AskMerra supports it.

group.label: Catalog
group.comment: What AskMerra learns about your products. Saving changes here sends the whole catalog again. Note: AskMerra re-reads a product with AI (billed as usage) when its name, description, categories, brand or attributes change - pick attributes that describe the product, not ones that change every day.

field.label: How AskMerra gets the catalog
field.comment: Push API sends changes within about a minute and removes deleted products. Feed publishes a file that AskMerra downloads every 1 to 6 hours (depending on your plan) - add its URL in the AskMerra dashboard, under Catalog > Add source > Feed URL.

field.label: Product identifier
field.comment: How products are matched between Magento and AskMerra. Product ID never changes; choose SKU only if your other AskMerra data already uses SKUs. Changing it later replaces the whole catalog in AskMerra.

field.label: Product attributes to include
field.comment: The details the assistant can use to answer and filter: e.g. skin type, ingredients, colour, size, material. Sent with their store view labels. Select several with Ctrl/Cmd. Avoid stock, prices and dates - they are sent separately.

field.label: Description
field.comment: Sent as plain text (HTML, Page Builder styles and widget codes are removed), up to 20,000 characters.

field.label: Include variant options
field.comment: For configurable products: the sizes, colours... a shopper can choose are sent as attributes of the product. The product itself is sent once, not once per variant.

field.label: Images per product
field.comment: The main image comes first; the chat shows it on the product card.

field.label: Include out-of-stock products
field.comment: Recommended: the assistant then knows the product and can say it is out of stock - it never recommends it. With No, products leave AskMerra while out of stock.

field.label: Exclude categories
field.comment: Category IDs, separated by commas; their subcategories are excluded too. To leave out single products, set Hide from AskMerra on the product (AskMerra tab).

group.label: Sync
group.comment: Only what changed is rebuilt and sent: product, price and stock changes - also those made by imports and ERP integrations - are picked up within about a minute (Magento cron and the AskMerra product sync indexer on Update by Schedule, set on install). Every day the module also adds products that are missing in AskMerra and removes the ones that left the catalog. Large catalogs are fine: 50,000 products are not rebuilt unless they change.

field.label: Products per request
field.comment: Push API, 1 to 500. Lower it if products have very long descriptions.

field.label: Daily maintenance at
field.comment: Server time. Adds missing products, removes products that left the catalog, picks up special prices that start or end today.

field.label: Full rebuild
field.comment: A safety net: every product is rebuilt and compared - still only changed ones are sent. Runs at the maintenance time, spread over the following minutes.

group.label: Product feed
group.comment: Used by the store views whose catalog is sent as a feed. Each store view has its own feed URL.

field.label: Format
field.comment: JSON carries every selected attribute. Google Shopping XML can also be used for Google Merchant Center, but only keeps standard attributes (colour, size, material, gender, GTIN, EAN, skin type, ingredients, volume, weight...).

field.label: Regenerate the feed
field.comment: Only changed products are rebuilt; the file itself is rewritten from them in seconds, and only when something changed. Keep it at least as often as AskMerra downloads it (every 1 to 6 hours, depending on the plan).

group.label: Storefront widget
group.comment: Look, greeting, colours and where the chat shows are set in the AskMerra widget designer. Headless storefronts (PWA Studio, ScandiPWA...) read these settings with the GraphQL query askMerraWidgetConfig - see the module README.

field.label: Widget script URL
field.comment: The src of the snippet in the AskMerra dashboard (Install); the snippet's other value is the site key above. The script is added to the <head> of every page - Luma, Hyvä and ScandiPWA alike.

field.label: Open on page load
field.comment: Desktop only.

field.label: Show on the checkout page
field.comment: Off by default so shoppers are not distracted while paying. The order success page always loads the widget when orders are reported.

field.label: Know the product being viewed
field.comment: On product pages the assistant knows which product the shopper is looking at ("Is this good for dry skin?").

field.label: Add to cart from the chat
field.comment: Simple products go straight into the Magento cart and the mini cart refreshes; products with options (sizes, colours...) open their page. Also turn on "Show add to cart" in the AskMerra widget designer.

field.label: Report orders to AskMerra
field.comment: On the order success page, so AskMerra can show the sales the assistant helped with. No name, e-mail or address is sent - only the order number, total and products.

field.label: Analytics consent
field.comment: Orders are reported only with the shopper's analytics consent. Automatic: read from Google Consent Mode / Google Tag Manager. Magento cookie notice: when the shopper accepts Magento's cookie notice. Not needed: no consent banner is required on this site. Manual: your cookie banner calls AskMerra.setConsent({analytics: true}).

field.label: API URL
field.comment: Change only for an AskMerra test environment.

field.label: Debug log
field.comment: Writes every request and response to var/log/askmerra.log. Errors are always logged.
